Introduction
Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint condition that leads to the gradual breakdown of articular
cartilage and remodelling of the underlying bone. The patient described morning stiffness
lasting less than thirty minutes, which is consistent with a mechanical rather than
inflammatory process (Brophy & Fillingham, 2022).
Management should begin with education and a structured exercise programme, because
strengthening the quadriceps reduces pain and improves function for most patients. Weight
reduction is also recommended when the body mass index exceeds the healthy range, and the
clinician should revisit these goals at every follow-up visit.
Brophy and Fillingham (2022) argue that conservative management should precede surgery,
while Moseng et al. (2024) emphasise exercise. Smith and Berman (2022) describe the
inflammatory pathway in detail (see https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2022.0786 for the full
statement).
